paper.title_en: Gravitational Wave Background from Metastable Current-Carrying Cosmic Strings
paper.abstract_en: We study the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) generated by networks of current-carrying metastable cosmic strings (MSCSs). Extending previous studies, we include the possibility of vorton formation phenomenologically. We construct an analytical template that provides a fast and accurate approximation to the spectrum in the frequency range probed by pulsar timing arrays (PTAs). We also show how the parameters of cosmic string networks determine the low-frequency slope. For the frequency range relevant for LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK), we derive an analytical expression that constrains the scale-invariant part of the SGWB. Finally, we confront the model with current constraints from PTAs and the LVK collaboration. We identify regions of the parameter space that can produce a signal consistent with PTA observations but are in tension with LVK constraints, suggesting that additional mechanisms to suppress the high-frequency spectrum are required for a consistent interpretation of the PTA signal

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究携带电流的亚稳宇宙弦网络产生的随机引力波背景，直接面向脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）频段，构建了快速准确的解析模板，并与PTA及LVK的现有限制进行对比，指出可同时解释PTA信号又受LVK约束压力的参数区域，与PTA主题高度相关，理论深度与可读性较好，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 亚稳载流宇宙弦产生的引力波背景
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由载流亚稳宇宙弦（MSCSs）网络产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB）。在扩展先前研究的基础上，我们以唯象方式纳入了涡旋子（vorton）形成的可能性。我们构建了一个解析模板，该模板在脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）探测的频率范围内为谱提供了快速且准确的近似。我们还展示了宇宙弦网络参数如何决定低频斜率。对于与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）相关的频率范围，我们推导出一个解析表达式，用以约束SGWB的尺度不变部分。最后，我们将该模型与PTAs和LVK合作组的当前限制进行对比。我们确定了参数空间中可产生与PTA观测一致信号、但与LVK限制存在紧张关系的区域，这表明需要额外的机制来压低高频谱，才能对PTA信号作出一致的解释。
